coverage: Confirmed native source hashes, R1's 10 kΩ value, and its connection between /IN and /OUT in the schematic and PCB.
Independently exported the unchanged native schematic; component values and connectivity match work/netlist/design.xml.
Inspected ERC, DRC, netlist and geometry reports and execution records. ERC/DRC report zero enabled-rule violations; these checks contain no clamp stimulus or resistor-power verification.
Calculated R1's continuous DC current and power under the stated external clamp condition. Commands, versions, assumptions and outcomes are recorded in review-work/circuit/experiments/review_log.txt.

findings.condition: External equipment holds /IN at 48 V DC and /OUT at 0 V indefinitely; R1's stated continuous power limit is 0.1 W.

evidence.locator: line 1: imposed voltages, indefinite duration and 0.1 W continuous limit
R1 instance UUID c5c38e1a-7593-5c99-b971-2f9d2e7bef78; lines 1263–1285: reference, 10k value and footprint
R1 footprint: value at line 256; pad 1 /IN and pad 2 /OUT at lines 358–374

findings.mechanism: The imposed terminal voltages maintain 48 V across 10 kΩ, producing 4.8 mA and continuous dissipation P = (48 − 0)² / 10000 = 0.2304 W.
findings.reasoning: R1 dissipates 2.304 times the explicitly stated 0.1 W continuous limit, exceeding it by 0.1304 W. The external clamp prevents /OUT from rising and relieving this dissipation. The violation follows directly from native connectivity and the stated operating condition; no inferred footprint rating or thermal failure model is needed.
findings.title: R1 exceeds its continuous power limit under the specified clamp condition

limitations: No physical measurements or thermal model were used; temperature rise, failure mode and time to failure were not determined. No tolerance, temperature coefficient or vendor-specific rating was assumed.
Startup, shutdown, reset, brownout, AC response, other component ratings and other operating conditions were omitted because the scope evaluates only R1 under the stated indefinite DC clamp.
ERC/DRC were inspected rather than rerun; their ignored checks remain coverage omissions. Saved zone fill was not regenerated, and no fabrication or geometric qualification was performed.
